cases.description: tsigState is TSIG_UNSIGNED (0); isSigned() should return false.
tsigState is TSIG_INTERMEDIATE (2); isSigned() should return false.
tsigState is TSIG_SIGNED (3); isSigned() should return true.
tsigState is TSIG_VERIFIED (1); isSigned() should return true.
tsigState is TSIG_FAILED (4); isSigned() should return true.
tsigState is an undefined value (99); isSigned() should return false, ensuring unknown states are treated as unsigned.
tsigState is a negative value (-1); isSigned() should return false, confirming that out‑of‑range negative states are treated as unsigned.
tsigState is just above the highest defined constant (5); isSigned() should return false, ensuring values beyond TSIG_FAILED are not mistakenly considered signed.
tsigState is Integer.MAX_VALUE; isSigned() should return false, verifying behavior with extreme positive integers.
tsigState is Integer.MIN_VALUE; isSigned() should return false, confirming that extreme negative integers are also treated as unsigned.
